reserveReview.rationale: Accountable dashboard timestamp 1793116808995 (2026-10-27T16:00:08.995Z; identical payload on the cache.accountable.capital mirror) reports USD 289,824,852.77 gross reserves: STRC 126,576,230.28, Cash & Equivalents 24,441,892.78, Other 5,796.94, Protocol Owned Liquidity 68,427,016.90 and Inventory 70,373,915.87. The five disclosed amounts reconcile exactly to the gross total. Issuer definitions exclude nonredeemable Inventory and POL from external backing, giving a USD 151,023,920.00 denominator. Independently dividing the three external amounts by that denominator and rounding to six decimals gives 83.812041%, 16.184120% and 0.003838%. No public supply logic, favorable category upgrade or invented residual is introduced. Wolf's August securities examination remains historical sleeve-only evidence, not complete-reserve or liability assurance.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Accountable timestamp 1793116808995; USD category amounts excluding issuer-documented nonredeemable Inventory and POL; each external category divided by USD 151,023,920.00
